title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance Game Expansion's Trailer Introduces Gundoraja
content:
CAPCOM revealed during Sony 's State of Play on Thursday the first trailer for the upcoming Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance expansion for its Monster Hunter Wilds game, and it teases a new Elder Dragon Gundoraja.

The Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance major expansion will launch in 2027.

The expansion adds Boost Drivers, attacks that activate Boost, which temporarily enhances certain actions. Boost introduces new combos, enhanced attacks, enhanced guarding, and more.

The Monster Hunter Wilds game debuted globally on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in February 2025. The game sold over 8 million copies worldwide in its first three days. According to the company, this is the fastest that one of its titles has reached this milestone. As of March 2025, the game had sold 10 million copies worldwide. The game is also in development for Nintendo Switch 2.

The first title update for the game launched in April 2025. The second title update launched in June 2025. The third title update featured a collaboration with Final Fantasy XIV Online and launched in October 2025. The game's fourth free title update — which included the Elder Dragon Gogmazios, Arch-Tempered Jin Dahaad, the "Festival of Accord: Lumenhymn" event, armor transcendence, and more — launched in December 2025. The update was the "final major content update" for the game that brought the addition of a new monster to the game's roster.
author: ANN

title: New Resident Evil Reboot Film Unveils Video Clip
content:
Sony Pictures Entertainment began streaming during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday a video clip for the new live-action reboot of CAPCOM 's Resident Evil survival horror game franchise . The video features the film's star Austin Abrams as Bryan:

The film stars Austin Abrams ( Weapons , Euphoria , Wolfs ) as Bryan. The cast also includes Zach Cherry, Kali Reis, and Paul Walter Hauser ( Richard Jewell, Black Bird , The Fantastic Four: First Steps ).

Zach Cregger ( Barbarian, Weapons ) directs the new film.

Constantin Film and PlayStation Productions are producing the new reboot film. Shay Hatten ( John Wick: Chapter 4 , Zack Snyder's Army of the Dead ) co-wrote the screenplay along with Cregger. Constantin's Robert Kulzer, Vertigo Entertainment 's Roy Lee ( Minecraft ), Miri Yoon ( Woman of the Hour ), and PlayStation Productions are producing. Nicole Brown is overseeing the movie. Dariusz Wolski is the director of photography. Sources told The Hollywood Reporter that Cregger's film would "take the title to its horror roots and be more faithful to the initial games."

Sony also released the previous movies in the franchise . Four studios, including Warner Bros. and Netflix , were bidding for the film rights.

This film will be the eighth live-action film in the franchise . The first six films in the franchise opened between 2002 and 2017, and all starred Milla Jovovich.

Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City , the first live-action film reboot in the franchise , opened in the United States in November 2021, and then opened in Japan in January 2022. The film is set in the late 1990s, has a completely original story, and features characters from multiple games in the series. CAPCOM producer Hiroyuki Kobayashi ( Resident Evil 4, Sengoku Basara ) supervised the project.

Resident Evil: Death Island (Japanese title: Biohazard: Death Island ), the latest CG animated film in the franchise , opened in July 2023.

The Strong National Museum of Play in Rochester, New York inducted the 1996 Resident Evil game into the Video Game Hall of Fame in 2024.

The Resident Evil requiem ( Biohazard requiem ) game launched on February 27 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store. The game has exceeded 6 million units in cumulative sales worldwide. The game is the fastest to reach the milestone in the Resident Evil series.
author: ANN

title: emaqi Adds Bloody Sugar Laughs at the Night, Misato Is a Little Too Strict with Her Pushover Boss, 6 More Manga
content:
AI localization company Orange Inc. announced on Thursday it will release the following manga titles in English on its e-bookstore service " emaqi " on the following dates (manga marked as such will also be available as part of emaqi Premium):

Title: Bloody Sugar Laughs at the Night (vols. 1-3) Author: Matsuri Mido Release Date: September 4 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: A strange disease that preys on people's negative emotions called negativirus has been sweeping the town of Dusky Dusk. Different varieties have varying symptoms, but most people can't even see them. Luckily, the cool and collected Church and his brother, the hotheaded Jed, can, and they've made it their mission to fight back as specialists against this mysterious affliction and save patients' lives. But they also seem to be on the hunt for a specific negativirus strain that may help their beloved young sister, Basil...! Don't miss this dark, sweet fantasy from rising star author Matsuri Midou!

Title: Misato Is a Little Too Strict with Her Pushover Boss (vols. 1-3) Author: Kurotama Release Date: September 4 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: Misato is a drop-dead gorgeous office worker who's highly capable at her job. Her middle-aged boss, Mr. Konishikawa, is way too soft on his subordinates, which is why Misato is always strict with him, but just what feelings could be hiding beneath her harsh demeanor?! The curtains open on this age-gap workplace romcom, where the contrast between strictness and sweetness will leave you swooning!

Title: The Witch's Soup (vols. 1-2) Author: Masayasu Fukushima Release Date: September 11 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: Eld Elflaim, a witch who has descended to the surface world to save the Demon Realm from its crisis. A master of soup-making, she plots the annihilation of humanity with her supreme "poisoned soup," but then she happened to taste a soup from the human world. Its flavor was on an entirely different level, and she found herself completely captivated! A full-fledged cooking fantasy!

Title: Do Women Really Need Plastic Surgery? The Chaos Behind Cosmetic Surgery (vols. 1-2) Author: Pachimi (original concept), Bera Kaneko (art) Release Date: September 11 Synopsis: 【We're Spilling All the Secrets of Plastic Surgery!】 Satomi Akagi is just starting Out as a beauty clinic nurse aide. A senior colleague still in a facial cast, a patient dead set on looking like an anime character, and just who would even ask for hymen restoration surgery?! There's so much information Out there about plastic surgery — but what's it actually like? Find Out in this workplace comedy. ※This work does not promote or endorse plastic surgery.

Title: Thursdays with Furutto (vols. 1-3) Author: Masakazu Ishiguro Release Date: September 11 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: Life moves at a gentle pace for the semi-stray, Furutto, and his hopeless owner, Kujirai-senpai... Put your feet up and enjoy the laid-back feline comedy!!

Title: CAT : The Heroic Warrior (vols. 1-3) Author: Hikaru Kusunoki Release Date: September 18 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: Awakening from his long slumber, the Demon King rises once more! Humanity summons their only hope, a hero from another world. But what was waiting for them when the smoke cleared was none other than... a perfectly normal cat. The people of the otherworld, exposed for the first time to a cat's charms, fall head over heels in this adorable cat fantasy!!

Title: Midori's Kitchen (vols. 1-4) Author: Yoshika Aki Release Date: September 18 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: The world has been over­taken by car­niv­o­rous meat-plants. Cast Out into a silent world where nei­ther ani­mals nor humans remain, sis­ters Midori and Sakura begin a new life in the logis­tics ware­house of "Jun­gle," a major mail-order com­pany, just to keep them­selves alive. For Sakura, who can't step Out ­side because of the meat-plants, Midori makes the most of their lim­ited ingre­di­ents to recre­ate the dishes of their mem­o­ries.

Title: A Chef of Nobunaga (vols. 1-3) Author: Mitsuru Nishimura (story), Takurō Kajikawa (art) Release Date: September 25 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: Modern-day chef Ken awakes to find himself in the Sengoku period. On catching wind of a chef making waves in Kyoto, Oda Nobunaga forces Ken to become his personal chef...?! An unprecedented historical culinary epic woven from warfare and cuisine! The "Sengoku Eats" columns and recipes are also a must-read!

emaqi also stated more than 70 new volumes of existing emaqi -exclusive series will join the subscription service this month, including: From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated! (vol 9), OUT (vols. 12-18), and Rokudo’s Bad Girls (vol 12).

Orange Inc. was founded in April 2021, and announced in July 2023 it had raised US$1.8 million. The company established its headquarters in the U.S. in March 2024.

Orange Inc. launched the app version of emaqi in May 2025.

The emaqi Premium monthly subscription launched on July 1.
author: ANN

title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 Anime Reveals Theme Song Artists
content:
The second season will premiere on October 1. The new season will again air on Thursdays at 11:56 p.m. (10:56 a.m. EDT) on TBS and 27 affiliated channels. It will also stream on Netflix , as well as other services in Japan.

The manga centers on Koyuki Hikawa, an aloof high school student who has a hard time getting close to others, and who builds a wall between herself and other people. Although she spends her time alone at school, for some reason Minato Amemiya keeps getting closer to her. The frustrating story of youth follows the lives of four somewhat complicated individuals: Koyuki and Minato, plus the popular girl Miki and the laid-back boy Yōta.

The cast includes:

• Anna Nagase as Koyuki Hikawa

• Fūka Izumi as Miki Azumi

• Shōya Chiba as Minato Amamiya

• Satoshi Inomata as Yota Hino

• Chiaki Kobayashi as Tsubasa Igarashi

• Sakura Shinfuku as Tsukiko Shimojima

• Akari Kitō as Momoka Kuriki

• Kakeru Hatano as Yūki Azumi

• Natsumi Kawaida as Akine Atagawa

Mankyū ( Pui Pui Molcar the Movie: MOLMAX , Sumikkogurashi – Good to be in the corner , The IDOLM@STER Shiny Colors ) is directing the anime at Studio KAI . Yasuhiro Nakanishi ( Kaguya-sama: Love is War , Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun , Mecha-Ude: Mechanical Arms ) is in charge of the series scripts. Miki Ogino ( Osana Najimi no Carbou ) is designing the characters. Kanade Sakuma and Natsumi Tabuchi are composing the music.

The first season premiered on TBS and 27 affiliated channels on April 2 at 11:56 p.m. in Japan. The season then debuted globally on Netflix on April 2, and it is also streaming on other services in Japan.

Agasawa ( You and I Are Polar Opposites ) originally serialized the manga as a webtoon on the LINE Manga app from January 2020 to April 2022. Shueisha published the manga's 14th and final compiled volume (reorganized for volume format) in February 2025.

The manga ranked at #15 for male readers in the 2024 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook in December 2023, and also was nominated for the 69th Shogakukan Manga Awards in 2023. The manga placed second in May 2024 in the "Vertical Scroll Comic" section of the second Rakuten Kobo E-book Awards. Additionally, the manga ranked #2 on AnimeJapan's sixth "Most Wanted Anime Adaptation" poll in 2023.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Releases Creditless First Anime Ending Featuring "Michishirube" by Keita Tachibana
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its very first ending, featuring the song “Michishirube” by Keita Tachibana. The song was used in Episodes 1-12, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the first opening featuring “Drawing days” by SPLAY . The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the second entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!
author: Anime Corner

title: Fungus and Iron TV Anime Reveals Director, Yokohama Animation Lab Animation Studio
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Ayaka Katayama 's Fungus and Iron ( Kin to Tetsu ) manga revealed the anime's second teaser visual and director, on Thursday. Keitarō Motonaga ( The Beginning After The End two seasons, Date A Live three seasons, Getbackers ) is directing the anime at Yokohama Animation Lab .

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing Fungus and Iron digitally, and it describes the manga:

Dante's life on Amigasa seemed normal enough to him, even though everyone around him called him an oddball. But when a chance meeting with a young woman named Aoi changes everything, Dante can no longer sit idly by...unless, of course, he is made to!

Katayama launched the manga in Kodansha 's Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine in March 2021. The manga went on hiatus in August 2021 when Katayama began her maternity leave. It then resumed serialization in March 2022. The manga will end serialization on September 9. Kodansha published the manga's first compiled book volume in July 2021, and will publish the 10th and final volume on October 8. Kodansha USA released the ninth volume in English digitally on July 21.
author: ANN

title: Shungiku Uchida's Minami's Lover Manga Gets Musical Stage Play in December
content:
A website opened on August 31 to announce the musical stage play adaptation of Shungiku Uchida 's Minami's Lover ( Minami-kun no Koibito ) manga, which will run on December 6-16 at the Nippon Seinenkan Hall in Tokyo. The musical adaptation will have the lead high school couple Minami and Chiyokō (character name romanization not confirmed; Chiyomi in the original manga) as a male couple.

Idol group OCTPATH member Shunsei Ōta (second from left in image above) and Who-ya of Who-ya Extended (left) will both play the role of Sōsuke Minami. ICEx member Sena Takeno (third from left) and actor Ryō Sekoguchi (right) will both play the role of Chiyokō Horikiri.

Additional cast members include (from top left to bottom right in image above, some character name romanizations are not confirmed):

• Yumiko Takahashi as Karasu no Shiro

• Yūka Tano as Mitsuki Nomura

• Yūka Akino as Maina Kita

• Rion Hatakeyama as Masaya Shingū

• Ryōta Nakata as Kazu Nakatsukasa

• Seishiro Higurashi as Aoto Furukawa

• Ōyama Masashi as Kiyoshi Minami

• Hanayo Kimura as Minami Minami

• Yohei Izumi as Tsuyoshi Horikiri

• Haru Kasamatsu as Hitomi Horikiri

• Yūki Mao as Ritsuko Ogimura

• Kazumasa Koura as Principal

Yuka Arai is writing the script, Tsuneyasu Motoyoshi is directing the musical and is in charge of lyric composition, Oreno Graffiti is composing the music, and Genta Yamaguchi is in charge of choreography.

Fantagraphics is releasing the original manga in English and describes the story:

In this raunchy, moving, funny manga for adults, high school student Minami's girlfriend, Chiyomi, shrinks down to six inches tall — and moves in with him! Originally appearing in the underground/alternative manga magazine Garo in the 1980s and adapted for television several times, the Japanese pop culture sensation Minami's Lover is the story of two high schoolers' romantic relationship when one of them shrinks down to six inches tall. Everyone thinks Chiyomi has disappeared, and suspicion naturally falls on Minami, identified as her boyfriend in her diary. But after inexplicably finding herself in such a state, Chiyomi moves in with him. As depicted in Uchida's clean, loose line and Zip-a-Tone textures, the two soon adapt to the unusual circumstances, devising ways for Chiyomi to use the toilet, brush her teeth and hair, attend classes, and more. After some silly sequences of trial and error, they even figure out a sex life. But in addition to learning how to navigate logistics, jealousy, and the cat, they're also growing up (if not taller). Uchida uses the conceit of a teen couple literally learning how to take care of one another to examine gender dynamics and intimacy.

Uchida first published the manga in her Shungiku manga collection. It was then serialized in Katsuichi Nagai and Seirindo Co., Ltd. 's Monthly Manga Garo magazine from 1986 to 1987, with the final chapter appearing in a volume released by Seirindo in July 1987. Bungei Shunju collected and reprinted the series in 1998, and Seirinkogeisha published a revised edition in 2004.

The manga has been adapted into a live-action television special in 1990, an 11-episode television series in 1994, another 11-episode live-action television series in 2004, another television adaptation in 2015, and the fifth and most recent live-action series adaptation in 2024. The 2024 series had the roles reversed, with the boyfriend shrinking instead of the girlfriend.

title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance Expansion Introduces Boosted Actions Feature in Videos
content:
CAPCOM revealed a new trailer on Wednesday for the upcoming Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance expansion for its Monster Hunter Wilds game introducing the Boosted Actions feature.

CAPCOM also revealed videos on Wednesday and Thursday detailing the Boosted Action feature for different weapon types. These videos outline Great Sword and Bow.

The Monster Hunter Wilds game debuted globally on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in February 2025. The game sold over 8 million copies worldwide in its first three days. According to the company, this is the fastest that one of its titles has reached this milestone. As of March 2025 the game had sold 10 million copies worldwide.

The first title update for the game launched in April 2025. The second title update launched in June 2025. The third title update featured a collaboration with Final Fantasy XIV Online and launched on October 7.

The game's fourth free title update — which included the Elder Dragon Gogmazios, Arch-Tempered Jin Dahaad, the "Festival of Accord: Lumenhymn" event, armor transcendence, and more — launched on December 16. The update was the "final major content update" for the game that brought the addition of a new monster to the game's roster.

Monster Hunter Wilds is also in development for Nintendo Switch 2.

title: 'Mahou no Shimai Lulutto Lily Part 2' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, Theme Songs
content:
The official website of the Mahou no Shimai Lulutto Lilly ( Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly ) original television anime revealed an additional pair of cast, theme songs, and the main visual (pictured) for its second part on Thursday.

The second part is scheduled to premiere on October 4 at 10.30 p.m. Tokyo MX, followed by broadcasts on ABC TV, TV Aichi, BS Nippon Television, and AT-X.

Voice actors Yuusuke Shirai ( Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru ) and Yuuko Natsuyoshi ( Hanazakari no Kimitachi e ) are joining the cast as Mutchi and Shiromofu, respectively.

South Korean girl group ILLIT ( Himesama "Goumon" no Jikan desu 2nd Season ) is performing the opening theme "Swingin' Magic," while idol unit Lulutto Lily is performing the ending theme song "Dream à la Mode."

Shintarou Douge ( Arknights: Perish in Frost assistant director) is returning to helm the anime at Studio Pierrot . Yuuko Kakihara ( Hataraku Saibou ) is handling the series composition and script. Hirono Nishiki ( Shiunji-ke no Kodomotachi animation director), Mami Sodeyama ( Daitoshokan no Hitsujikai ), and Namiko Torii ( Totsukuni no Shoujo (2022) animation director) are designing the characters. ha-j is composing the music.

The Pierrot Magical Girl Series spanned from 1983 to 1988 and includes five classic titles: Mahou no Tenshi Creamy Mami ( Magical Angel Creamy Mami ) (1983–1984), Mahou no Yousei Persia ( Persia the Magic Fairy ) (1984–1985), Mahou no Star Magical Emi ( Star Magician Magical Emi ) (1985–1986), Mahou no Idol Pastel Yumi ( Magical Idol Pastel Yumi ) (1986), and Mahou no Stage Fancy Lala ( Magical Stage Fancy Lala ) (1998).
